hook: $86 million vanished after a hardware implant hit CryptoBilis wallets.

sections.voiceover: $86 million vanished after a hardware implant hit CryptoBilis wallets.
b_roll: Macro shot of a hardware crypto wallet PCB under an inspection microscope

sections.voiceover: Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis sold compromised devices across Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Bitquery tracked 311 wallets compromised in the supply chain attack. Where did 92.9 million dollars go?
b_roll: Animated map of Southeast Asia highlighting Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines
Data stream graphic showing wallet addresses

sections.voiceover: But Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant inside the seized devices sold by CryptoBilis.
b_roll: Close-up of a disassembled circuit board with an unverified microchip

sections.voiceover: Tether froze 10 million dollars of the stolen funds following the unauthorized tampering. Bitquery recorded total losses exceeding 86 million dollars across the networks.
b_roll: Bar chart showing total losses escalating

sections.voiceover: Ledger paused all sales via CryptoBilis after the massive breach drained 311 wallets.
b_roll: Company sales portal showing temporarily suspended inventory
